observations: Close-up of a sewing machine control panel.
The text 'EM81' is clearly visible in red on a black background in photo 0.
The machine has a black adjustment dial with a red ring.
The machine body is off-white or cream-colored.
A watermark 'NATHANZ SEWING EQUIPMENT' is visible across the image.
The photo is a close-up, showing the control panel and part of the machine's edge, but not the full machine or its surroundings.

claims.evidence: Requires a video of the machine in operation to confirm the motor type.
photo 0 shows the EMEL brand and model.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, the needle moving, and the motor running.

risks.risk: The photo is a close-up and may not represent the full condition of the machine.
risks.proof: Photos of the complete machine from multiple angles, including the needle area and the underside.
risks.if_unproven: as a used unit with unknown condition

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential accessories like the bobbin case or foot pedal.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included parts laid out.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing.
Photos of the full machine from multiple angles.
Photo of the bobbin area and the foot pedal.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photo. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
